name: Ikinari Anata ni Koishiteiru
original_name: いきなりあなたに恋している
source:
High-spirited Tane, bitter smiling Eika, cold gazing Ryou and new resident Tsumugu. How did Chouji’s normal life suddenly become like the Palace of Versailles? The story is constructed like a slice-of-life light novel, albeit with lots of ichaicha since there’s four heroines who are already at max affection with him.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/07/01/july-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
性格活潑的胤、笑容苦澀的詠歌、目光冷淡的涼，以及新近住進來的紡。重耳原本平凡的生活怎麼會突然變得像凡爾賽宮一樣？故事採用日常系輕小說式結構，不過四名女主角對他的好感度一開始便已達到最高，因此包含大量甜蜜互動。

[出自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/07/01/july-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
